title: SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of a Specify skill definition file.

name.description: Skill identifier; lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; max 64 chars (Anthropic syntax). Must be plugin-qualified (e.g. `spec-init`, `omnia-crate-writer`); the per-plugin prefix invariant and global uniqueness are enforced in `scripts/checks.ts` because JSON Schema cannot see the surrounding directory. Avoid reserved words `anthropic` and `claude` (Anthropic platform policy).

description.description: One-line description stating both what the skill does and when to use it, in third person (max 1024 chars per Anthropic spec). Avoid XML tags.

argument-hint.description: Cursor slash-command placeholder text rendered after `/plugin:skill ` in chat. Convention: short, single-line; `<arg>` for required positional arguments, `[arg]` for optional ones. No `--flag` prefixes — flags are documented in the SKILL.md body. The shape constraints (no `?`, `--`, or `|`) are enforced by `scripts/checks.ts`.

allowed-tools.description: Space-separated tool names (matches Cursor and Claude Code spec). Optional; omit to inherit the caller's tool set.
